Name: Shake all trees
Author: aoxiaofeng
Description:
Hardwood is in high demand in many genres, but shaking and pounding the seeds of peach blossom trees every day takes a lot of time, so I made this simple
Single module.

Function of the mod:
When holding any axe, press the middle mouse button (default) once
① Shake all the trees in the current scene
② Shake all the fruit trees in the current scene
③ Knock out all tree seeds in the current scene

The above functions can be enabled or not on the mod configuration page.
Supported languages: Chinese, English
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

硬木是许多流派大量需要的，但每天摇桃花心木和敲桃花心木林的种子很耗时间，所以我做了这个简
单的模组。

模组的功能：
手持任意斧头时，按一下鼠标中键（默认）即可
（1）摇晃当前场景所有的树木
（2）摇晃当前场景所有的果树
（3）敲掉当前场景所有的树种

以上功能可在模组配置页面选择是否开启。
支持语言：中文，英文
